searchText: I believe that the "Motivation" section describes the reasoning behind the entire EIP, and the "Rationale" section describes the reasoning behind any choices made inside the EIP itself. <@689161464829050960> is correct. Motivation is meant to describe why the described thing should be a standard (e.g., what problem does it solve). Rationale is meant to explain why specific technical decisions were made in the specification. I think the bot shouldn't close issues which serve as discussion URLs. Since supporting that may be quite a bit of work, and given most issues are actually discussion URLs, I suggest to stop the bot from doing it for the time being,. Thanks for the feedback, <@!301186049323958275> ! Going to share now. Let's see if we get any folks interested 🙂
